population: 120 frozen complex tasks; 40 per graph scale
metric: gold evidence IDs visible anywhere in the frozen condition context

interpretation.supported: Under a fixed 160-record budget, flat-hybrid evidence visibility degrades sharply with graph scale while hierarchical graph retrieval remains stable.
interpretation.not_supported: This retrieval curve alone does not establish answer-quality superiority, statistical significance, or neural-dense inferiority.
interpretation.analysis_role: pre-generation retrieval-level secondary endpoint and mechanism diagnostic
